messages:
nora: quick heads-up: onboarding template fails on Cloudflare Pages for new users after the exports map cleanup.

nora: runtime error: "TypeError: RetryPolicy is not exported from 'redwood-sdk'" and editors show "Could not find a declaration file for module 'redwood-sdk'".

liam: can you paste the package.json from the template? wondering if we removed the top-level '.' export.

nora: snippet we shipped in the template:
```json
{
  "exports": {
    "./*": "./dist/*",
    "./package.json": "./package.json"
  },
  "main": "./dist/index.cjs",
  "module": "./dist/index.mjs"
}
```

yejin: ah this is the wildcard-only pattern again. subpath wildcards don't forward .d.ts and bundlers will prefer module/main differently. our ESM bundle is a default-only rollup output so named exports like RetryPolicy are missing in ESM-only runtimes. CJS still exposes them which hid this in local dev.

matt: quick repro i ran: create a fresh ESM project and `import { RetryPolicy } from 'redwood-sdk'` -> build: "RetryPolicy is not exported". if i `import Redwood from 'redwood-sdk'` then `console.log(Redwood.default)` shows the real exports under default.

liam: immediate fixes: patch templates to include a top-level `"types"` pointing at `dist/index.d.ts` and add an explicit `"."` conditional export mapping with `import` and `require` fields. also update the ESM build to preserve named exports.

nora: workaround for affected users: `import Redwood from 'redwood-sdk'; const { RetryPolicy } = Redwood.default ?? Redwood;` nasty but unblocks Pages.

build-bot: filed issue RED-6010 and opened draft PR liam/exports-interop: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/1409 \u2014 adds `"."` export, `"types"` top-level, and a small rollup plugin to keep named exports in ESM output.

yejin: longer-term: add CI smoke tests that install the built package into pure-ESM sandboxes (Pages emulator / Bun / Deno) and run `tsc --noEmit` against templates so we catch both runtime and typing regressions. also add a linter check to forbid `require()` in onboarding templates.

matt: i'll update onboarding docs + internal checklist and ping support about the handful of signups that hit this. will mark blocked until PR merges.

liam: i'll land the PR after CI. thanks for the report nora. :thumbsup:
